description: One element of the model. An instance path (airliner.leftEngine) returns its size and position, children, values, ports, connections and the requirements it satisfies; a qualified name (MidsizeAircraft::Engine) or simple name returns its declaration outline.

root.description: The top level part usage to elaborate (default: the last one, the configured system).

text.description: The complete SysML v2 model text. The server keeps no state: pass the whole current text on every call, and after an edit use the text the edit returned.

title: Look up one element
